n.exclusions: No self-insight exclusions reported. Three noncodable experiential purchase costs affect the separate cost comparison; subsequent analyses unchanged whether those participants included or excluded.

notes:
Target is the true-self insight test, not purchase satisfaction (Study 3A-1) or materialism correlation. Original PDF text extraction misencodes mathematical symbols; quotes normalize these glyphs to their mathematical forms. Replication source is a frozen browser parse of full publisher HTML sections, including title, methods and target results; direct publisher terminal request returned 403. Replication page locator resolved by named HTML section. Both titles verified against assigned references. No statistics converted.
Completion source review (n_o): Explicit 121-person Study 3A cohort; all insight responses scored, no target-specific exclusions reported. Footnote 4 distinguishes three missing purchase costs from subsequent analyses. Participant analytic role established by the described insight procedure and result; not inferred from degrees of freedom.
Completion source review (es_value_o): The target one-sample insight test explicitly prints d = 0.371 and t(120) = 4.08; preserve d without conversion.
Completion source review (pval_value_o): Same one-sample insight test prints p < .001. Canonical extraction represents the less-than glyph as a double quote; retain bound l and literal canonical evidence.
